description.zh:
异步模式调用：
* false（默认）：命令执行完成后，api 才会返回
* true：命令后台执行，api 立即返回。调用方需要记录返回值中的 TaskId，然后来 DescribeClusterPolicy 查询命令的执行状态。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use asynchronous mode. Valid values:
* false (default): The API returns a response only after the command is executed.
* true: The command is executed in the background, and the API returns a response immediately. Record the TaskId from the response, and then call DescribeClusterPolicy to query the execution status of the command.

description.zh:
音频：
* on（默认）：打开，客户端可以听到云桌面内部的声音。
* off：关闭，客户端听不到云桌面内部的声音。
description.en:
The audio policy. Valid values:
* on (default): enabled. The client can hear audio from the Cloud Desktop.
* off: disabled. The client cannot hear audio from the Cloud Desktop.

description.zh:
剪贴板：
* off：关闭
* read：只可读
* write：只可写
* readwrite：可读写
description.en:
The clipboard policy. Valid values:
* off: disabled.
* read: read-only.
* write: write-only.
* readwrite: read and write.

description.zh:
域名白名单
* 白名单为空时，允许访问所有域名
* 白名单非空时，仅允许访问列表中的域名
* 支持 `*` 通配符
* 多条域名规则之间用逗号分隔
* 设置后对当前集群的所有实例即时生效
description.en:
The domain name whitelist.
* If the whitelist is empty, access to all domain names is allowed.
* If the whitelist is not empty, only domain names in the list are accessible.
* The `*` wildcard is supported.
* Separate multiple domain name rules with commas (,).
* The settings take effect immediately on all instances in the current cluster.

description.zh:
本地磁盘映射：
* off：关闭
* read：只可读
* readwrite：可读写
description.en:
The local drive mapping policy. Valid values:
* off: disabled.
* read: read-only.
* readwrite: read and write.

description.zh:
udp 端口：
* on（默认）：打开。推荐配置为 on，带宽占用与网络稳定性更好。
* off：关闭。定位 udp 相关的网络问题时，有时需要在这里设置 off，设置后安全组入方向的 1494 / 2598 的规则会被移除
description.en:
The UDP port policy. Valid values:
* on (default): enabled. We recommend that you set this parameter to on for better bandwidth usage and network stability.
* off: disabled. To troubleshoot UDP-related network issues, set this parameter to off. After this parameter is set to off, the inbound security group rules for ports 1494 and 2598 are removed.

description.zh:
USB 重定向：
* off：关闭
* on：打开
description.en:
The USB redirection policy. Valid values:
* off: disabled.
* on: enabled.

description.zh:
水印：
* off：关闭
* on：打开。水印为星状覆盖屏幕的两行半透明文字，格式为集群信息与主机信息，类似
    * gws-xxx@gws
    * c0-i00-xx-t6
description.en:
The watermark policy. Valid values:
* off: disabled.
* on: enabled. The watermark consists of two lines of semi-transparent text in a star pattern that covers the screen. The text displays cluster information and host information in the following format:
    * gws-xxx@gws
    * c0-i00-xx-t6.
